messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "40 mg orally once daily until day 28"
set: ["40 mg orally once daily until day 28", "40 mg orally once a day", "40 mg once daily", "20 to 40 mg orally once a day", "5 mg to 40 mg once daily", "4 mg orally once daily", "25 mg orally once daily", "study (n=54) took 40 mg orally once a day", "40 mg orally once a day for duodenal ulcer", "40 mg twice daily", "40 mg orally twice daily for 7 days", "30 mg orally once a day", "60 mg orally once a day", "20 mg orally once a day", "50 mg orally once a day", "850 mg orally once a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
